description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LocationEmployeeCount' within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. The class encapsulates information about a specific location and the employee count associated with it, including properties for location ID, name, and employee count, along with corresponding constructor and getter methods.

classes.name: LocationEmployeeCount
classes.description: A data transfer object representing employee count data per location, including location ID, name, and employee count.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing location ID, name, and employee count.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees at the location.
